login.title: Sign in
login.description: Use your account credentials to sign in.
login.redirecting: Taking you to the sign-in page…
login.signedOut: You are signed out. All products share one sign-in, so the other products are signed out too.

register.title: Request an account
register.description: An administrator will review your request. Once approved, sign in with this email and password.
register.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. your team and what you need access to (optional)
register.submitted: Request submitted. Once an administrator approves it, you can sign in with the email and password you just set.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot password
forgotPassword.description: Enter your email and we will send a reset link.
forgotPassword.sent: If that email exists in the system, a reset link has been sent.

password.hint: At least 12 characters and not a common password.

invitation.title: Accept workspace invitation
invitation.description: You have been invited to join the workspace “{{workspace}}”.
invitation.descriptionWithInviter: {{inviter}} invited you to join the workspace “{{workspace}}”.
invitation.newAccount: This email address does not have an account yet. Set a name and password to create one and join the workspace.
invitation.existingAccount: This email address already has an account. Sign in to accept the invitation.
invitation.mismatch: You are signed in as {{current}}, but this invitation is for {{invited}}. Sign out, sign in with the invited email address, and open the link again.

callback.title: Sign in
callback.failed: Sign-in did not complete; the link may have expired or already been used. Please sign in again.
